completeness.why: getUpcomingDates and both schedule-template sites pass their raw enable flag and mode to applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay, which decide whether and how to move the date; getNextDate calls applyWeekendRule but computes the enable flag itself as '!!skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend', so whether the rule applies is still settled at that site (the noSkipWeekend option is not a named parameter of the definition), scored partial per the lower-level rule.

interface.why: applyWeekendRule takes just the date, the enable flag and the mode, with each caller mapping its own field name (weekendSolve vs weekendSolveMode); the day-string variant is a convenience wrapper, but the noSkipWeekend override is folded into the flag at the caller rather than made explicit, and the wrapper repeats the enable ternary instead of delegating.

disguised_duplication.where: applyWeekendRuleToDay in shared/schedules.ts re-states the 'skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date' decision of applyWeekendRule with string conversion around it instead of calling applyWeekendRule.
